test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Choose the coasts that are running along the Arabian sea.

a. Northern Circars

b. Malabar

c. Konkan

d. Coromandel
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only b and c**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Malabar Coast** and the **Konkan Coast** run along the Arabian Sea.
 
• The **Malabar Coast** stretches along the southwestern shore of the Indian subcontinent, primarily in the state of Kerala.
 
• The **Konkan Coast** extends along the western coast of India, covering areas of Maharashtra, Goa, and Karnataka.
 
• The **Northern Circars** and the **Coromandel Coast** are located along the Bay of Bengal on the eastern side of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Arabian Sea is part of the northern Indian Ocean, bounded on the north by Pakistan and Iran, on the west by northeastern Somalia and the Arabian Peninsula, and on the east by India.
 
• The **Western Ghats** run parallel to the western coast of India, creating a distinct climatic and geographical divide between the coastal plains and the inland regions.
 
• The coastal regions along the Arabian Sea are known for their unique ecosystems, including mangroves, estuaries, and backwaters, which support diverse flora and fauna.
 
• These coastal areas have been historically significant for trade, with ancient ports facilitating maritime commerce between India and other civilizations.
